text.html:
Sponsored articles

Betting brands can pay us to publish articles about their products. Those articles are labelled Sponsored on every listing and above the headline, name the brand that paid, and carry a note explaining that they are advertising.

Links in sponsored articles are marked as paid links for search engines.

What sponsors cannot do

  • Pay for or edit our news and guides
  • Include offers or inducements in their articles
  • Remove the Sponsored label

Corrections

If we get something wrong, we correct it and show the date of the update at the top of the article.

Gambling help

Free, confidential support is available from Gambling Help Online on 1800 858 858. BetStop lets you exclude yourself from every licensed provider.
